answer: Real identities leave receipts; fake ones leave excuses. Device sensor fingerprint collects the receipts: a sensor fingerprint measured live from the applicant's own phone. The ember of the check is that every receipt was written by someone else, years ago, for a different reason - taxes, licences, work - so no applicant could have staged them for this test. One fake needs a full set, and the pulse in the middle is the clerk who must be fooled in person. The trellis that seals it is the registry: it either lists the applicant, or it does not.
